note: The template gallery and the Quick Survey picker read this one file (src/config/surveyTemplates.ts, scripts/seo-prerender.mjs). Never rename a published slug. Rules: anonymous unless a template needs to know who answered (those say so on their first line); health templates ask about experience only; dietary options are choices, never allergies; Pro group breakdowns follow the minimum of 5; generic wording, no customer named.
